thread:
Anya: Heads-up — I ran the Q3 hosted API capacity sim with the new seasonal curves. Key ask: decide buy vs short-term rental mix by EOD Thu.

Mike: numbers?

Anya: Short summary: baseline median demand => +320 GPU-hours/day peak, 90th percentile => +540. If we buy to cover 90th with a 2x warm pool we need ~40 A100-class GPUs. Ballpark capex per GPU ~ $180k one-time; 12mo amortized TCO ~ $30k/GPU/mo. Rental market avg seen in quotes ~ $6.5 / GPU-hour (US primetime), spikes in APAC.

Jess: Can you paste the sim command + a tiny output?

Anya: Sure — this is the exact run I pushed: 
```bash
python infra/sim.py --horizon 90 --seed 42 --demand data/q3_curve.csv --buy-gpus 40 --rent-rate 6.5 --qopt true
```

Anya: Short log extract: 
```
run sim-2112223333: horizon=90, qopt=on, demand_median=320h, demand_90p=540h
buy_plan=40, warm_pool=0.20, rental_budget_est=$62k/mo
expected_spend_buy=+$1.2M capex, expected_rental_cost=~$745k/90d if heavy burst
```

Mike: 6.5/hr sounds high for bulk leases — is that vendor list or marketplace?

Anya: It's blended: vendor short-term pods + marketplace spot for APAC spikes. Procurement gave us temp quotes that averaged there during primetime windows. Spreadsheet with vendor breakouts: https://docs.redwood.com/sheets/q3-capacity-ask (internal)

Pri: Proposal from infra: commit to 25 buys now, keep current warm pool at 25% of baseline, and set aside $60k/mo for rentals to handle bursts. That reduces immediate capex and leaves runway for model optimizations.

Sid: Risk note: APAC supply constraints — if we undercommit we may hit fallback model routing to EU/US which increases latency for enterprise customers. Back-of-envelope: 1% increase in latency failures could roughly map to $1.2M ARR risk across high-sensitivity customers. Need mitigation plan.

Jess: Did the sim include the qopt (quantization) reduction? That changes GPU-hours materially.

Anya: Yes — qopt flag enabled in this run; we assume a 12% demand reduction per request. With qopt the buy need drops from 40 -> ~35 GPUs for the same SLOs. I also ran a no-qopt scenario for sensitivity.

infra-bot: capacity-sim v2 completed successfully (run id: sim-2112223333). Outputs uploaded to infra/sim/outputs/sim-2112223333.csv

Mike: Can we stretch the commit decision to next Wed? Legal needs to review lease clauses (early termination / spike penalties). Finance needs 12mo runway calc for both 25-commit and 40-commit.

Anya: Fine with Wed. Action items: 1) Jess add qopt sensitivity table + nvlink SKU delta to the sheet, 2) Finance produce 12mo TCO for 25 vs 40 buys and monthly rental budget scenarios, 3) Procurement to obtain 30/60/90-day rental quotes and APAC-specific lead times. I'll re-run sim with APAC regional shortages and attach the CSV.

Pri: Also recommend we earmark a small nvlink-enabled pool for large-batch customers; treat it as separate SKU and cost center.

Jess: Will add nvlink column and a short note on customer impact.

Anya: Thanks — reconvene Wed 10am PT. /cc @finance-team @procurement @platform-ops

Mike: thanks all :thumbsup:
